claims: Dark Winds has been officially renewed for a fifth season.
Production of Dark Winds season 5 begins in March 2026 in Santa Fe, New Mexico.
Dark Winds season 5 will consist of eight episodes.
Dark Winds season 5 is scheduled to premiere on AMC in 2027.
Zahn McClarnon will return as Lt. Joe Leaphorn.
Kiowa Gordon will return as Jim Chee.
Dark Winds season 4 premieres on February 15, 2026.
Paola Núñez joins the cast as Luisa Alvarado.
Luisa Alvarado is a lead investigator for the U.S. Attorney's office.
Martin Sensmeier joins as Terry Bai.
Terry Bai is a former Vietnam veteran.
Filming for Dark Winds season 5 takes place in Santa Fe, New Mexico, during spring 2026.
Dark Winds continues to adapt the Leaphorn & Chee book series by Tony Hillerman.
Dark Winds focuses on 1970s New Mexico.
Dark Winds season 4 adapts The Ghostway.
As of early April 2026, Dark Winds is in active production on its eight-episode run.
Zahn McClarnon serves as an executive producer.
